S2=300 is the speed of spindle 2, named by its number; this run scales only the speed of the main spindle, spindle 1, so it is left as it is. Switch on "Also scale other spindles" to scale it with the others.

SVC[2]=90 is the speed of spindle 2, named by its number; this run scales only the speed of the main spindle, spindle 1, so it is left as it is. Switch on "Also scale other spindles" to scale it with the others.
